pages.text: [#](53341a)The wolf's curse comes in through a rite, or through the attention of one already afflicted, and it does not announce itself politely. The full moon forces the change; the rest of the time you choose — though choosing gets harder as the moon waxes.[#]()
pages.title: Lycanthropy

pages.text: [#](53341a)In wolf form the body is stronger, faster, and harder to slow, while the mind remains your own, more or less. Find the Wolf Altar and tend it. Mastery matters.[#]()

[#](53341a)Strength and speed well beyond a human's in wolf form. Regeneration mends the body. With the right talisman, a howl becomes a weapon. The Wolf Altar grants mastery from zero to three — and mastery three is not subtle.[#]()
pages.title: The Wolf's Gifts
